ItemPicker
public static class ItemPicker.Builder extends AbstractPanelElement.Builder<ItemPicker, ItemPicker.Builder>
Builds an ItemPicker. One lens is required.

    • state

      public ItemPicker.Builder state(Supplier<net.minecraft.world.item.Item> get, Consumer<net.minecraft.world.item.Item> set)
      The 6.1.0 lens: one item, the kind only (ItemMatch.Match.ITEM). get is read every frame (Items.AIR, or null, for none); set receives the item the player picks, or Items.AIR when they empty it.

    • stack

      public ItemPicker.Builder stack(Supplier<net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack> get, Consumer<net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack> set)
      One stack: get read every frame, set handed every change (ItemStack.EMPTY for none).

    • stacks

      public ItemPicker.Builder stacks(Supplier<List<net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack>> get, Consumer<List<net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack>> set)
      A list of stacks, in the player's order: set gets a new list with no empty entries.

    • rule

      public ItemPicker.Builder rule(Supplier<ItemMatch> get, Consumer<ItemMatch> set)
      One slot with its own match mode (set gets an empty stack for none).

    • rules

      public ItemPicker.Builder rules(Supplier<List<ItemMatch>> get, Consumer<List<ItemMatch>> set)
      A list of slots, each with its own match mode.

    • match

      public ItemPicker.Builder match(ItemMatch.Match match)
      How the setting compares stacks (ItemMatch): ItemMatch.Match.ITEM (the default) keeps the kind of item only and shows no Edit tab; ItemMatch.Match.EXACT and ItemMatch.Match.CONTAINS keep the whole stack and edit it.

    • playerChoosesMatch

      public ItemPicker.Builder playerChoosesMatch()
      The player chooses each slot's match, "Any <item>" (ItemMatch.Match.CONTAINS) or "Exactly this" (ItemMatch.Match.EXACT), in the Edit tab; match is a new slot's. Needs rule or rules, which store the choice.

    • ignoring

      public ItemPicker.Builder ignoring(net.minecraft.core.component.DataComponentType<?>... types)
      Component types the setting leaves out of the comparison, in EXACT and CONTAINS (ItemMatch.ignoring(DataComponentType...)): every rule the picker writes ignores them. ignoring(DataComponents.DAMAGE) for a rule that still holds once the item is worn.

    • ignoringCount

      public ItemPicker.Builder ignoringCount()
      The setting leaves the count out of EXACT (ItemMatch.ignoringCount()): every rule the picker writes ignores it, and the Edit tab has no count, so a slot holds one.

    • label

      public ItemPicker.Builder label(net.minecraft.network.chat.Component label)
      The dialog's title, and what the narrator reads. Default "Choose an item", or "Choose items" for a list.

    • columns

      public ItemPicker.Builder columns(int columns)
      A list's slots to a row, fewer when the panel is narrower. Default ItemPicker.DEFAULT_COLUMNS.
